experiment: Kalshi market making: v1 against the v2 engine
phase_rule: every v2 arm quotes normally, goes reduce-only once its position could not be unwound in time (5x the time to trade it at 10% of the market's 24h volume), and rests what is left at the touch to close in the last 2 hours (niche) / 15 minutes (hourly crypto)

previous_phases.change: no aggro close; v2 rested its reducing side only where the edge curve allowed and held the rest to resolution
previous_phases.result: No verdict: 10 of the 14 clean days needed. Running totals v1 -$25.28, v2_niche -$12.24, v2_crypto -$44.32; v2 would have broken even at a 28bp (niche) / 41bp (crypto) maker rebate.

previous_phases.change: aggro close at all times: any v2 position rested at the touch to close
previous_phases.result: Stopped after 3 scored days on its own kill criterion (negative realized PnL per resolved contract). v1 -$1.98/day (unchanged), v2_niche -$7.72/day, v2_crypto -$41.87/day; break-even maker rebate 87bp (niche) / 172bp (crypto).

arms.name: baseline
arms.description: v1 unchanged: Avellaneda-Stoikov quotes around the touch mid on niche markets, crossing the spread to flatten before game windows and closes.

arms.name: v2_niche
arms.description: v2 engine on the same universe: edge curve around a depth-weighted mid, never crosses, reduce-only instead of flatten, holds to resolution. Phase 3: quotes normally, goes reduce-only once its position could not be unwound in time (5x the time to trade it at 10% of the market's 24h volume), and rests what is left at the touch to close in the last 2 hours (niche) / 15 minutes (hourly crypto).

arms.description: v2 engine on hourly BTC/ETH strike ladders, fair value from Binance anchored to the Kalshi book, exposure netted across strikes. kill_criteria: A treatment whose realized expectancy per resolved contract is negative after 200 contracts is stopped.
Any aggregate exposure breach, or a position held into a resolution rule nobody read, stops that arm until fixed.
Written before the first v2 paper fill (2026-09-25), carried unchanged into phase 2 (2026-10-30); not moved after seeing results.
caveats: Paper fills. v2's venue is stricter than v1's: v2 queues behind the size at its own price and waits 0.5s for acks and cancels; v1 queues behind the top of book and fills instantly. That bias works against v2.
v1 marks open inventory at the last mid it saw; v2 holds to resolution and settles at 0 or 100.

Phase 3 started every arm from flat on 2026-11-04 (v1 unchanged): every v2 arm quotes normally, goes reduce-only once its position could not be unwound in time (5x the time to trade it at 10% of the market's 24h volume), and rests what is left at the touch to close in the last 2 hours (niche) / 15 minutes (hourly crypto). Phases 1 and 2 are archived in the repo (archive/phase1/, archive/phase2/) and are not mixed into these numbers.
Days lost to the laptop sleeping are lost for every arm at once, and are excluded from the per-day statistics rather than scored as zero (automation/downtime.json).
